"Had a wonderful dining experience at Thamaq Multicuisine Restaurant on Bagalur Main Road. The place boasts a spacious, eye-catching ambiance with neat interiors and plenty of parking space, making it a great spot for families and groups.
We tried a mix of their Arabic specialties and starters, and the flavors were genuinely impressive—the grill and chicken dishes were juicy, well-marinated, and cooked to perfection. Portion sizes are quite generous for the pricing, giving you good value for money.
The only minor drawback was the service speed, which got a bit sluggish during peak hours, and a couple of items we wanted were sold out. However, the polite staff and the delicious food more than made up for it. Finishing the meal with their hot lemon tea was absolute perfection.
A solid 4-star spot in Yelahanka for Arabic and multi-cuisine food lovers. Will definitely visit again!"

Good food, disappointing service!

Visited Thamaq for dinner today and ordered Dal Tadka, Tandoori Roti and a Pineapple Murukku Sarbath. The food was good, and the Dal Tadka and rotis were satisfying. A special shout-out to the Pineapple Murukku Sarbath, a Kerala-style drink that was absolutely amazing and definitely worth trying!
Unfortunately, the service and hygiene need serious improvement. I had to ask three times for onions and chutney. When they finally arrived, they were served in a steel bowl that didn't look hygienic, with a tiny piece of lemon and a disappointingly small quantity of accompaniments. There was no salt, pepper, spoon or fork available on the table either.
The most frustrating experience was with the billing. While I was still eating, the waitress brought the bill to my table. I ignored it and continued with my meal. Barely a minute later, she returned and reminded me, "Sir, your bill." I had to ask whether I could at least finish my dinner before being asked to pay. She then told me to continue eating. Bringing the bill while a customer is still eating is one thing, but repeatedly reminding them to pay before they've finished is simply poor service.
On the positive side, the food is tasty, the restaurant attracts a good crowd, parking is plentiful, and it stays open until late at night. The overall hygiene is a little questionable but manageable.
My verdict: Thamaq has the food and location to attract customers, but the staff needs proper training in hospitality, service etiquette and basic table hygiene. Good food can bring customers in, but poor service can just as easily drive them away.
I'm giving 3 stars: one star deducted for staff behaviour and another for poor service and hygiene.

reviews.author: Geo Rajan
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this restaurant.

The hygiene standards were worse. The washroom was very poorly maintained and had a terrible smell. I could barely stand inside for a minute because of the smell. The wash area was also dirty, with food particles left around. For a restaurant, maintaining cleanliness in these areas should be a basic priority.

I brought the issue to the attention of the billing counter, but the response was that there was a shortage of water. If water is unavailable to maintain basic sanitation, the washroom should be closed temporarily or the restaurant should make alternative arrangements. Simply continuing to operate with such poor hygiene is not acceptable.

I also had stomach issues the following day. I cannot conclusively attribute this to the food, but given the overall experience, it was understandably concerning.

The combination of disappointing food, blood in the chicken and extremely poor hygiene made this a very unpleasant experience. I would not recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Gracy N
reviews.text: Well, after a long ride from Bidadi. We were very hungry and after seeing good for reviews for Thamaq, we decided to give it a try. Unfortunately the excitement and enthusiasm all went for a toss, when after 40 mins We were still didn't get the order that we placed. Customers who came after us got their orders and we were blankly staring at each other's faces. Finally when we got the order our hopes went high, however, needless to say we were again utterly disappointed with the chicken ghee roast which came as a dish that was made out of sheer neglect and was so sour, the naans were cold and the ghee rice had no cashews or raisins or any other whole spices that were supposed to be in the dish. The only thing that did justice to the dinner was the coconut and mango pudding. The waiter and the manager tried their best to apologize but this could have been resorted in a much better way. Also the washroom stinks strongly of urine you could almost throw up. Advice:- please don't fall for tall claims through Google reviews.

Another sad reality is that , even if you see so many waiters and staff walking around, nobody comes themself to take your order unless you call out to them
